text: Woman: Hey.
John.
This looks like a great party. [Yeah!] Thanks for inviting me.
Man: No problem.
Glad you could make it.
Hey.
Have you met any of the famous guests so far?
Woman: Uh, no. Who exactly?
Man: Well, there is Gregorio Zuttlemisterburger . . . [Who?].
Ah.
They call him the “Grip” for short.
Woman: Who in the world is he?
Man: You’ve never heard of him? [No.] He’s the world famous snake trainer . . .
He’s never met a snake he couldn’t train to dance and hiss at the same time.
Woman: Seriously?
Where is he?
Man: Uh, he’s the tall guy over there in the purple jacket and green pants.
He probably has a snake or two with him tonight.
Woman: Huh?
Man: And then there is Georgina, the Great.
Woman: Georgina . . . and great for what?
Man: Are you serious?
You’ve never heard of her?
She is the world’s greatest arm wrestler.
I mean, World champion.
She’s the petite woman next to the fireplace with the bright yellow dress and the tennis shoes.
Woman: I thought you said famous people . . . like, like people we all know.
Man: And, and there is Brad Pitt . . .
Woman: Now, there’s someone I recognize . . .
Man: . . . the captain of the national Yo-Yo team [What?].
Yeah.
He’s the short, stocky man sitting at the table wearing the black and red checkered shirt.
I’m sure he’d do a few tricks for you if you asked.
Woman: Uh, no thank you.
I think I’ve had enough entertainment for one evening.
Man: Okay.
